bead.title: Document OpenRouter and OpenAI-compatible signal gaps
bead.description: Inventory routing-evidence surfaces for OpenRouter and generic OpenAI-compatible providers. Document context-limit discovery, quota headers, cost attribution, and the absence of a provider-owned live utilization probe in this step.
bead.acceptance: 1. The matrix or companion note classifies OpenRouter and generic OpenAI-compatible providers as ranking-only or documentation-only for utilization. 2. Existing context-limit and quota/cost probes are mapped to the matrix. 3. Missing live-utilization probes are listed as explicit follow-up beads or explicitly marked unavailable.
